summary: Chapter 2 dramatizes Feuz uncovering the twenty-year-old Vogel file and confronting Stettler and Rutz, but it repeatedly displaces load-bearing canon facts (victim's name, Melchior's autopsy status, Stettler's office, the reused formula) and drifts two characters out of their canon identities, so it does not earn its place as written.

issues.fix_hint: restore the name to Klara Vogel; cut the invented first name 'Anna' and the invented maiden name 'geborene Aebi'
cut the Sektionsbefund from Melchior's file; canon records no autopsy was performed on him

issues.unit: das Präparat, das man im Magen gefunden hatte
issues.fix_hint: cut the poison-in-stomach detail; Melchior's death was a fall with no autopsy, not a poisoning
call him Amtsarzt, as canon does, not Amtsstatthalter, and remove the later repetition of the title

issues.unit: der Pfarrer stand in der Tür
issues.fix_hint: name him Rutz / Pfarrer Rutz explicitly here; he is the same creditor named earlier in the chapter, not a second, unnamed priest

issues.unit: Zu Hause hatte Berta die Suppe schon aufgetragen
issues.fix_hint: cut this scene of Berta serving Feuz in his home; canon has her as Melchior's widow, not a housekeeper in Feuz's household
restore the reused formula to the certificate phrase 'Herzversagen, vermutlich beim Sturz', not a poison's chemical composition

issues.unit: Drei Wirte hielten Zettel, der Bären, der Kreuz, der Löwe
issues.fix_hint: canon is silent on the number and names of innkeepers Melchior owed; fine as invention, but reconcile into canon if kept
double-underlining is Feuz's own habit in canon; clarify this is his private observation, not attribute it to the old file's signer without comment
